g.text: Adding PMM improves 1997/2015 retrospective skill, but worsens 2023
Five February–June starts per event; lines show the full available seasonal trajectories
Scores: 25 overlapping start–season pairs, 9 unique targets/event, common center leads 1–5; r is event-pooled Pearson correlation.
Frozen 2002–2024 fits: 1997 uses later-fitted parameters; 2015/2023 are in sample. No post-start observed forcing.
RO uses SST and GODAS mean D20. The PMM extension refits the full operator; its difference is not a pure causal PMM effect.
